title: MIPR: A Benchmark for Reasoning-Intensive Multimodal Intent-to-Product Retrieval with Multi-Category Solutions
abstract: arXiv:2611.22509v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Real-world e-commerce queries often express user intent without naming a target product, and a single intent may be fulfilled by products from multiple categories. However, existing multimodal retrieval benchmarks typically assume a relatively well-defined target, leaving retrieval for intents with multi-category solutions less explored. To fill this gap, we introduce MIPR, a benchmark for Multimodal Intent-to-Product Retrieval comprising 3,522 multimodal queries and a shared corpus of 30,731 products. MIPR features reasoning-intensive retrieval, multi-category solutions, and fine-grained relevance labels. Experiments show that the best embedding-based retriever achieves 49.23% nDCG@10 on the full query set, and 55.86% solution-category recall@10 on queries with multiple solution categories. translated_title: MIPR：一个面向需要推理的多模态意图到商品检索（含多类别解决方案）的评测基准
translated_abstract: 真实世界的电商查询往往只表达用户意图而不指明目标商品，且同一意图可能由多个类别的商品来满足。然而，现有多模态检索基准通常假设目标相对明确，对具有多类别解决方案的意图检索探索不足。为填补这一空白，我们提出了 MIPR，一个多模态意图到商品检索基准，包含 3,522 条多模态查询和 30,731 个商品的共享语料库。MIPR 具有推理密集型检索、多类别解决方案和细粒度相关性标签的特点。实验表明，最好的基于嵌入的检索器在完整查询集上仅达到 49.23% 的 nDCG@10，在具有多个解决方案类别的查询上达到 55.86% 的解决方案类别 recall@10。通过重排，这两个分数分别提升至 60.11% 和 67.00%，但与候选池的乐观上限之间仍存在显著差距。这些结果确立了……（原文在此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了 MIPR 基准，首个针对需要推理、且一个意图可由多类别商品满足的多模态意图到商品检索任务，包含 3,522 条查询和 30,731 个商品，实验显示现有最优模型与理想上限仍有较大差距，凸显了该任务的挑战性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MIPR, a benchmark with 3,522 multimodal queries and 30,731 products for reasoning-intensive multimodal intent-to-product retrieval where a single intent can be satisfied by products from multiple categories, revealing substantial performance gaps between current best retrievers and the oracle upper bound.
